concept: On the eve of the school festival, two students race to restore the rooftop lantern lights after a sudden power failure.
story_outline: [0-12s] In the late afternoon, Hana notices the rooftop lanterns above the school courtyard stay dark while the festival preparations continue below. She spots a loose cable near the rooftop access door and calls Kaito over. [12-24s] Wind tugs at the hanging lights while the pair check the power box together. Kaito steadies the ladder as Hana climbs to inspect the connector. She says, 'Did you unplug it?' He looks up and answers, 'No. The wind pulled it loose.' [24-36s] Hana reseats the connector, but the lights only flicker once and go out again. Kaito braces the cable while Hana tightens the latch. She says, 'Try it now.' He flips the switch, and a few lanterns blink to life before the whole string brightens across the roof. [36-45s] The courtyard below fills with warm light as the festival begins. Hana and Kaito pause beside the rooftop rail, relieved, and watch the lanterns glow over the school. Hana smiles and says, 'We made it.' Kaito gives a small nod and replies, 'Together.'

primary_characters.name: Hana
primary_characters.description: High-school-aged girl with a short chestnut-brown bob, bright amber eyes, navy school blazer, cream cardigan, and white shirt.
primary_characters.personality: Capable, careful, and focused under pressure, with a dry sense of humor when she is tired. She takes responsibility quickly and prefers practical fixes over drama.
primary_characters.motivation: She wants the rooftop lanterns working before the festival begins so the courtyard feels warm and welcoming.
primary_characters.relationship_to_others: Kaito is the calm teammate who helps her stay steady when the deadline gets tight. Their dynamic should read as trust built through small acts of cooperation.

primary_characters.name: Kaito
primary_characters.description: High-school-aged transfer student with slightly tousled blue-black hair, cool gray eyes, navy school blazer, white shirt, and loosened dark tie.
primary_characters.personality: Quiet, grounded, perceptive, and practical. He notices small problems quickly and helps without making a scene.
primary_characters.motivation: He wants to help Hana fix the lights before the festival begins and keep the rooftop from becoming a bottleneck.
primary_characters.relationship_to_others: Hana trusts Kaito because he stays calm, follows through, and works beside her instead of taking over.
